title: m5stack/esphome#5 [m5_unit_acssr] Add support for the Unit ACSSR and DCSSR

execution.environment: macOS arm64; CPython 3.13 venv with repository requirements (ESPHome 2026.11.0-dev); ESP-IDF 5.5.6; local Device Service cores3 QEMU profile with the dcssr Unit model on PORT.A

checks.name: vendor protocol cross-check
checks.detail: 0x50/0x00/0x10/0xFE, transfer split, 3 s boot delay and relay-off initial state match the component

checks.name: config validation
checks.detail: Configuration is valid; default address 0x50, switch ALWAYS_OFF, light gamma 2.8

checks.name: virtual-device relay/LED data plane
checks.command: QEMU CoreS3 session + dcssr on PORT.A
checks.detail: QOM relay-level true->false with relay-transitions=2 and led-rgb=0xFF8000; UART0 setup finished and Firmware version 1

checks.name: no-unit reconnect path
checks.detail: after the retry window one 'not answering at 0x50' warning; update() kept probing 0x50

checks.name: restart-recovery fairness
checks.detail: QEMU DCSSR model does not reflect 0x10 LED readback, causing repeated restore warnings; real FW shadow readback is not exercised

checks.name: hardware validation
checks.detail: no ACSSR/DCSSR unit; contacts, load, isolation, LED optics and the real 3 s power-up window unverified

checks.name: Button / Modbus mode and 0x20 address change
checks.detail: out of scope for the I2C attachment and not implemented

notes: The DCSSR QEMU model is an I2C register/transaction observer, not a mains switch model; no electrical or contact claim is made.
The relay readback is the unit firmware shadow byte, not contact feedback.
